_comment: The forecast_meta.json a submission writes next to /output/forecast.parquet. Validated against qfbench2_common/schemas/forecast.schema.json by gate g1, and then bound to the trusted card by gate g2: unit_id, asof and target must EQUAL the card's. Every key below is one the scorer reads; the pre-freeze version of this file used forecast_id / card_id / output_format, none of which the schema declares, so an author who copied it produced a submission that failed g1.

rationale.method: joint gaussian random walk, no text
